title: Jupyter Vybe
description: Fine-grained AI code generation in Jupyter notebooks.

enabled.title: Enable Jupyter Vybe
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, prompt cells execute as ordinary code.

prefix.title: Prompt prefix
prefix.description: First character(s) of a code cell that mark it as a prompt. Cannot be '!', '?', '%' or anything that parses as code.

id.title: Agent
id.description: Measured on scripts/bench-quality.py: both models pick the right tool every time, but Gemma writes correct code more often (8/8 against 19/24) while qwen answers about fifteen times faster. qwen is the default because a first prompt at 25 seconds reads as broken; switch to Gemma when the code has to be right.

command.title: Command
command.description: Run with shell=False after shlex splitting, e.g. claude -p. The prompt is appended as the last argument.

commandPersistent.title: Keep the command running between turns
commandPersistent.description: Newline-delimited JSON on stdin/stdout, as claude -p --input-format stream-json. Falls back to one-shot if the handshake fails.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server, including /v1.

model.title: Model id
model.description: As the endpoint names it in /v1/models. A wrong id is the most common misconfiguration; the health check lists what is actually served.

apiKeyEnv.title: API key environment variable
apiKeyEnv.description: Read from the server's environment by name. The key itself is never stored in settings.

timeoutSeconds.title: Per-turn timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one turn may take before the round is abandoned.

persistent.title: Persistent conversation
persistent.description: Remember previous prompts and send notebook diffs. When off, every prompt is single-shot.

windowTokens.title: Model context window (tokens)
windowTokens.description: The model's context length. Used to decide what to trim, not sent anywhere.

reserveTokens.title: Reserved for the reply (tokens)
reserveTokens.description: Held back from the window for the reply, so a long notebook cannot crowd out the answer.

cellWindow.title: Full-fidelity cell window
cellWindow.description: How many cells around the prompt are sent in full. Cells outside it are summarised to a signature and a line count. 0 sends the whole notebook, which is what you want until a notebook outgrows the context window.

includeOutputs.title: Include cell outputs
includeOutputs.description: Send what the cells printed as well as their source.

maxOutputChars.title: Max characters per output
maxOutputChars.description: Longer outputs are truncated in the middle.

global.title: Global prompt
global.description: Always sent to the agent. Describe conventions you want all generated code to follow. Leave blank to use the shipped default.

showAssembled.title: Log the assembled prompt to the console
showAssembled.description: Prints the exact text sent to the model to the browser console.

kernelIntrospection.title: Kernel introspection
kernelIntrospection.description: Lets the agent read docstrings and completions from the running kernel. Never executes code.

maxInsertions.title: Max added cells
maxInsertions.description: Cells one round may add, however many the model asks for.

maxProposals.title: Max proposed edits
maxProposals.description: Edits one round may offer for review.

maxToolTurns.title: Max lookups per request
maxToolTurns.description: How many times the agent may look something up before it must answer.

autoScroll.title: Smooth-scroll between edits
autoScroll.description: Scroll between proposals as you accept or reject them.

acceptKey.title: Accept / reject keys
acceptKey.description: Whether accept is Y/N, or Enter to accept and Backspace to reject.

mergeCommentStyle.title: Comment style for merged edits
mergeCommentStyle.description: Comment marker for lines an Enter merge replaced. 'auto' follows the kernel's language.

completion.title: Inline completion
completion.description: Ghost text from a local model, on demand. Nothing is requested until you press the trigger key.

enabled.title: Enable inline completion
enabled.description: Suggestions are asked for with the trigger key below, never on a timer: each one costs a model call.

agentId.title: Completion agent
agentId.description: Which agent writes the suggestions. Blank uses the same one as the cell generations. Completions are asked for far more often, so a smaller, faster model usually belongs here.

triggerKey.title: Trigger key
triggerKey.description: CodeMirror key notation: Alt is Option on a Mac, Mod is Cmd there and Ctrl elsewhere. The default matches Copilot's trigger, which is the one combination the editors agree on and the one the window manager and the browser both leave alone. Tab and Shift+Tab are deliberately untouched: they are the kernel's completions and its docstrings, and this feature feeds on both.

maxLines.title: Lines per request
maxLines.description: How much is predicted at a time. Press the trigger again for the next line, so this is not a limit on how much you can get -- it is how much you are asked to read before deciding. A line that opens a block runs on until the code would parse, whatever this says: a loop header with no body is a syntax error, not a short answer.

timeoutSeconds.title: Give up after (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: A prediction is asked for deliberately, so it is worth waiting a little longer for than something that arrived uninvited.

maxEntries.title: Entries rendered at once
maxEntries.description: Older prompts stay on disk; this is only how many are drawn.

persist.title: Keep prompt history across sessions
persist.description: The prompt record lives outside the notebook, so deleting a prompt cell never loses the prompt.

location.title: History location
location.description: 'user' keeps the record in your config directory; 'adjacent' beside the notebook.

confirmRemoteAgents.title: Confirm before sending a notebook to a non-local agent
confirmRemoteAgents.description: Ask before a notebook leaves this machine.
